Luke, I appreciate you being upfront about the recovery costs, but I’d rather keep our incomes steady. Your schedule gives each of us 20 tons over three months; catching 10 tons each month gives each of us 30 tons over that same period, and the lake returns to 100 tons every month.

My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next catch. With five families depending on this lake, I propose we agree to 10 tons each this month, then review the reported catches together before setting next month’s quota. That’s $10,000 each without needing a shutdown afterward. John, would you support that instead?
